name: Krea 2 Turbo — dynamic character sheet (auto-prompt)
description:
Upload one picture of a subject — a person, an anime or game character, an animal, a creature, a robot, a vehicle or an object — and get back a full production-style character sheet on a 3:2 landscape page (1536x1024): a name and short visual description, a big hero view, a front/side/back turnaround, three action poses, silhouettes, an expression (or function) study and six close-up detail crops, all keeping the design from your picture.

There is nothing to type. A built-in vision-language model (Qwen3-VL) first looks at your image and writes the long, structured instruction the Dynamic Character Sheet LoRA expects — what kind of subject it is, its signature details, its rendering style — then Krea 2 Turbo draws the sheet. That writing step is why this takes longer than a plain edit.

'Likeness strength' controls how hard the model copies your picture (1 is normal, 3–4 is closer). 'Steps': around 8 sticks more strictly to the layout, 12 adds detail. The names and labels on the sheet are drawn by the image model, so expect the occasional misspelling.
author: conradlocke / comfyui-krea2edit (Dynamic Character Sheet LoRA)

exposedParameters.label: Subject image (a character, person, animal, creature, robot, vehicle or object)
Likeness strength (1 = normal, 3–4 = copy the design more closely)
Steps (8 = follows the layout more strictly, 12 = more detail)
